data.title: 黄泉 · 旅店雨声
data.description: 雨敲着旅店窗沿。黄泉穿居家长衫倚坐窗边，手搭在膝上，看着远处被雨雾遮住的街灯。
data.promptProse: Seated beside an expansive, rain-streaked window in a high-rise travelers' hotel, Acheron rests her chin in hand, watching neon amber and blue streetlights blur through the heavy downpour below. Raindrops race in shimmering rivulets down the glass, reflecting her quiet violet eyes as warm indoor lamplight softly illuminates the hotel room.
data.animaCaption: The streetlights blur beyond the rain. Gentle room light reaches her face and the hotel room beside the rainy window.
